text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka continues her dedicated 
efforts heading into the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

However, her body couldn't keep up with 
her ever-increasing speed to the limit, 
and Silence Suzuka began to feel pain in 
her leg.

Worried about the condition of Silence 
Suzuka's legs, Special Week advises her to 
withdraw from the Tenno Sho.

However, without bending her will in the 
face of her words, Silence Suzuka declared 
that she would take on the race.
